integrity: Symbolic proof supplied, standalone direct finite-field checks reproducible; finite checks are not infinite proof. Historical-priority risks from permutation-algebra literature disclosed; independent verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite fields and uniformly sampled labeled monomial structure matrices only; not arbitrary perfect evolution algebras, not random isomorphism classes, and not a complete distribution for the unrestricted invertible-matrix ensemble. Cyclewise idempotent equations and decomposition precede this result. The sharp asymptotic fixes the field and sends dimension to infinity.
title: Arithmetic idempotent-free phases in random monomial evolution algebras
